title: ProjectSpendAlert
description: Represents a spend alert configured at the project level.

id.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

object.description: The object type, which is always `project.spend_alert`.

threshold_amount.description: The alert threshold amount, in cents.

currency.description: The currency for the threshold amount.

interval.description: The time interval for evaluating spend against the threshold.

SpendAlertNotificationChannel.description: Email notification settings for a spend alert.

type.description: The notification channel type. Currently only `email` is supported.

recipients.description: Email addresses that receive the spend alert notification.

subject_prefix.description: Optional subject prefix for alert emails.
